description:
All of the Avengers Endgame HISHE cartoons exactly as before but now with Doomsday related post credits scenes.  Just like Encore did.  From the Trailer, to Captain America Returning the Stones, to the new Doctor Doom Hype Scenes. These Avengers HISHE's have been completely re-rendered to meet our new Infinite Visions quality standard.  Enjoy this special presentation!
